about_the_game:
The Oily Depths is a short horror game set in a submarine deep beneath the sea. You must locate and drill for oil or your overlords will stop your supply of oxygen.

PILOT YOUR SUB

Utilize all your gauges, meters, and monitors as your visibility is limited within the sub. Carefully navigate the sea floor to locate the oil extraction targets.

OPERATE DANGEROUS DRILLING MACHINERY

Flip levers, grab tools, set locking-arms, and more. You will need to gain a mastery of each part of your equipment until it's a part of you...

AVOID DROWNING, BURNING ALIVE, OR BEING EATEN...

"Not our problem. If you don't meet quota... We cut your oxygen."

-Corporate
